**Clips keep the visuals, not the brand and the people.**

Artspo saves a page's visual material: illustration and line art, diagrams, gradients, textures and grain, 3D renders and objects, photography of places and things, posters and type-led graphics, video loops, and Lottie and Rive files.

It no longer saves:
- **logos**, the site's own or anyone else's,
- **icons**,
- **photos of people**,
- **product UI screenshots**,
- **the site icon and share image**.

They're counted under "Left out on purpose" in clip.md. The icon-system line and the logo-wall description stay, so an agent still knows the style.

**New: curate.** The extension can only tell people and screenshots apart by their labels, and most real photos aren't labeled. Ask your agent to *"curate my clips"*. It builds numbered contact sheets with `curate.py`, looks at them, and sets aside what doesn't belong, moving files to `_set-aside/` (nothing is deleted) and fixing each clip.md. Contact sheets need Pillow (`pip install pillow`).

### Updating

`git pull`, click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`, run `sh install.sh` so your agent gets `curate.py`, then **↻ Re-inspect all** and ask your agent to curate.

### Files

- `artspo-0.9.4.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.9.4.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
